completed_local_gates.func_traceability: quality/traceability.json maps 15/15 requirements (FUNC-01..FUNC-15) to real executable CTest, Vitest, Playwright, and release qualification tests
completed_local_gates.release_package_staging: build/s7-qualification/rodaq-0.1.0-linux-amd64-humble.tar.gz (25,644,690 bytes, sha256=115d04c701c26a1f...) contains bin/rodaq, librodaq_plugin.so, librodaq_daq.so, public headers, CMake config (strictly exporting only rodaq::plugin & rodaq::daq), com.rodaq.acquisition.ros2@1.0.0, com.rodaq.storage.mcap@1.0.0 (behavioral fakes excluded), openapi.yaml, task_config.schema.json, and share/rodaq/web/*; zero build-tree RPATH leaks, zero Node.js runtime dependency
completed_local_gates.relocated_out_of_tree_sdk_replay: Unpacked release tarball to isolated prefix; built, installed, loaded, instantiated, and closed out-of-tree C11 plugin (com.example.s7.c_probe@1.0.0), C++17 plugin (com.example.s7.cpp_probe@1.0.0), and C++17 rodaq::daq + rodaq::plugin consumer via find_package(RoDAQ REQUIRED) + rodaq_register_plugin()
completed_local_gates.installed_ros2_humble_mcap_and_sigkill_r: Relocated bin/rodaq recorded 2 live ROS 2 Humble topics (/s7_chatter 100 Hz + /s7_telemetry 50 Hz) with 2s rotation -> 4 committed MCAP artifacts, Pause/Resume/Stop succeeded, HTTP Range 206 byte-exact verified, independent ros2 bag info verified both topics, SIGKILL crash during active run recovered in existing mode in 308.3 ms preserving 4/4 committed MCAP artifacts byte-identical, SIGTERM clean exit 0; dev-host telemetry (Intel Core Ultra 5 125H, Ubuntu 22.04, NVMe ext4): API p50=1.20 ms, p99=1.93 ms (36 samples), RSS max=51.5 MB, open FDs max=60, threads max=44
completed_local_gates.humble_regression: 18/18 S7 key CTests passed (all 11 Server/OpenAPI tests, Ros2Runtime FormalTask & Representative camera/joint tests, rodaq_counter_binary_matrix, rodaq_domain_binary_matrix, rodaq_runtime_sdk_consumer, rodaq_counter_independent_projects, rodaq_package_contract); full Humble regression baseline 798/798 executed passed in S5 with zero C++ changes since
completed_local_gates.ubuntu24_ros2_jazzy_replay: Docker ros2-bag-phase0:jazzy-amd64-local (Ubuntu 24.04 + GCC 13 + ROS 2 Jazzy): rebuilt rodaq_plugin, rodaq_daq, rodaq_ros2_acquisition, rodaq_mcap_storage with 0 warnings; 24/24 CTests passed (Ros2Runtime FormalTask/Representative/CustomMsg, Ros2SegmentRuntime, RodaqMeta, McapConfig/Qos/Storage, rodaq_package_contract)

external_blockers: 72-hour continuous engineering pre-qualification endurance run (real wall-clock time window)
7x24-hour (168-hour) continuous production endurance trial (real wall-clock time window)
Target industrial hardware qualification, heavy reference workload (100,300 rec/s / 909.44 MB/s), and physical power-loss testing (only dev-host and SIGKILL process crash tested here)
Native macOS Safari 16.4 runtime E2E verification (Ubuntu 22.04 Linux host tested Chrome 154, Edge 139, Firefox 159; Vite build.target includes safari16.4)
Ubuntu 24.04 + ROS 2 Jazzy Drogon 1.9.14 Server binary packaging (Drogon 1.9.14 prefix is currently prepared on Ubuntu 22.04 Humble host only; Jazzy Core + ROS 2 + MCAP verified 24/24)
Remote GitHub CI execution (local unpushed branch next per no-push rule; local CI-equivalent gates executed)
qualification: S7 Blocked (NOT Production Qualified). All locally executable Required integration, release packaging, relocated out-of-tree SDK replay, multi-browser Web E2E, Humble/Jazzy Core+ROS2+MCAP, and SIGKILL recovery gates passed. External wall-clock endurance, target hardware/power-loss, macOS Safari, Jazzy Drogon packaging, and remote CI remain required before declaring RoDAQ V1 Production Qualified.
